name: See3CAM_10CUG

sources.title: See3CAM_10CUG - 1.3 MP Global Shutter USB Camera (Mono) (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (onsemi AR0134), shutter, optical format, output format (YUY2 16 bits per pixel), pixel size, active area, FOV with e-con's lens, CS-mount, frame rates, external trigger, interface, power, weights, size (l x b)

note: A monochrome global-shutter USB 3.0 camera with a CS-mount; FOV 73.5 (D) x 58.9 (H) x 44.3 (V) degrees "with the lens provided by e-con". The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rates: the overview says "720p@60fps (HD) and 1280x960 resolution@45 fps (Full Resolution)" over USB 3.0, the key features "HD @ 60 fps & 1.3 MP @ 54 fps": the overview's figures (which name the stream size) are entered; 720p is 1280 x 720. Output "YUY2 (16bits per pixel YUV422 format)", as stated. power_w is the stated maximum, 0.90 W (minimum 0.87 W). mass_g is the board with lens and without enclosure, 100 g (without lens 23 g; with enclosure 72 g, or 149 g with lens). size_mm is null: the page gives only "40 x 44mm". External trigger input (optically isolated). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.

sync.what: Product page, key features: "External Trigger input (optically isolated)".
